question: Which 4.100.108 function implements the stock app-registry install path?
prototype_hypothesis: app_install(record, ordered_list, count) copies the app record, registers it into the global app registry list, and stores the ordered list for the launcher.
callsite_evidence: sub_C6A6BF8 decompiles to the stock app-install path and references the 'app_install' and 'free_app' strings plus the '[%s] %s: [%s] installation failed' error log
It copies the source record fields (name/icon handles at offsets +12/+16/+28/+32) into a freshly allocated 80-byte record via the strdup-equivalent sub_C3517E2
It links the new record into the global app list (off_20084E68) and allocates a 4*(count+2) buffer for the ordered list, then copies each ordered entry
It updates the launcher counters (word_20084E70/word_20084E74) and emits a 28-byte notification via sub_C8E6968
Produced by the multi-layer matcher from the verified 3.101.036 set and confirmed by decompiling the exact 4.100.108 IDB
control_flow_evidence: Fails closed (returns early) when the record or its name handle is null
On allocation failure it logs '[%s] %s: [%s] installation failed' and returns the error
The record type check (sub_C69BC40 on the app type word) guards against registering a non-app
Failure paths free the partially-built record (sub_C34CB9C) and the ordered-list buffer
ownership_analysis: The app registry owns the registered record after install; the caller's record is copied, not taken. Must run in the app-registry/launcher context (not a bare loader constructor).
unsafe_assumptions: The app-record field offsets (+12/+16/+20/+23/+24/+28/+32) and the global list base (off_20084E68) are exact 4.100.108 layout and are not portable
The launcher counter globals (word_20084E70/74) must be touched in the same context as other launcher mutations
recommended_probe: Install a native app via the Manager and confirm it appears in the launcher list and can be removed (free_app path).
